title: AICAR and AMPK Activation: What Laboratory Research Actually Shows
excerpt: AICAr forms ZMP and can activate AMPK, but knockout studies show that several metabolic effects are AMPK-independent. This RUO review explains the evidence and controls.
seoTitle: AICAR and AMPK Activation in Laboratory Research
seoDescription: Review AICAR uptake, ZMP formation, AMPK signaling, mouse evidence, off-target effects, analytical identity, and controls for RUO laboratory research.
